name: Socrates Jones: Pro Philosopher
source:
After an unfortunate accident, bumbling accountant Socrates Jones must find “the nature of morality” by debating philosophers to earn back his life. More than slightly influenced by the Ace Attorney series.

[From [url=http://www.kongregate.com/games/ChiefWakamakamu/socrates-jones-pro-philosopher]Kongregate[/url]]
translation:
在一次不幸的事故之后，笨手笨脚的会计师苏格拉底·琼斯必须通过与哲学家辩论来找到“道德的本质”，以挽救自己的生命。受逆转裁判系列影响不小。

[来自[url=http://www.kongregate.com/games/ChiefWakamakamu/socrates-jones-pro-philosopher]孔雷盖特[/url]]
